title: Rojava: A Land of Resistance and Freedom
content: Halwest Karim* The mother of the martyr Hevrin Khalaf1 called for Kurdish unity and said, “I will always follow Hevrin’s path and fulfill her dream.” Her words reflected a profound lesson in resistance not only for the Kurds but for all humanity. Hearing these words brought me back to the moment when this journey began. […]
